en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3711 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Al-Hasan ibn Salih Al-Thawri, from Abu Abdillah (as), regarding a man who dies while owing a debt, and a guarantor guarantees it for the creditors.
Imam (as) said: "If the creditors are satisfied with him, then the deceased is absolved of liability."
